description:
IRREVERSIBLE: Cancel a phone number

Cancels a number bought through the marketplace, with a 30 day grace period: the number is released at the carrier straight away but stays usable on the account until `cancelationEndDate`, and the record is kept rather than deleted. Only marketplace numbers can be cancelled here; a number that was imported by other means is rejected with 400. Cancelling twice is rejected with 409. This does not refund the setup charge or the month already paid for.

confirm.description: Leave out on the first call. EchoCall then answers with a confirmation value. Ask the user for a clear yes, then repeat the call with the same arguments and this value.
